The '''Enchant Crossbow Bolt''' spell is a [[members]]-only spell used to give gem-tipped [[Crossbow (weapon)|crossbow]] [[bolts]] special powers that have a chance of activating upon impact.

Although Enchant Crossbow Bolt is listed as one spell in a player's [[spellbook]] requiring 4 [[Magic]] to cast, the only bolts that can be enchanted at this level are Opal bolts. When attempting to cast Enchant Crossbow Bolt, an interface will appear, asking you to choose from up to 10 different [[spells]]. Each of these spells requires a different Magic level, different [[runes]], and grants different amounts of experience. When successfully cast, the message {{Mes|The magic of the runes coaxes out the true nature of the gem tips.}} is displayed.

Regardless of the spell cast or your Magic level, each spell enchants a set of 10 bolts. While this process is done at a set pace, you can hold down the space bar and rapidly click on the spell to speed up the process. Casting the spell does not interrupt skilling actions such as [[mining]] and [[fishing]], and can therefore be used as a [[zero time|zero-time]] method to train Magic.

After completing the [[hard Kandarin Diary]], enchanted bolts will have a 10% increased chance of the special effect activating (even in PvP).
